purpose: Teach: 吐き気/日本食/静寂/脱力/化合/矢先/在来/祭典

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは船酔いで吐き気をされたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father used to get seasick on the boats.
lines.style: Gentle, nostalgic opening. Soft voice, looking back. Measured pace. The tone of someone sharing a quiet memory, not making a point.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、日本食を心から愛されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear—and he loved Japanese food so much, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm affection layered under the words. Slight lilt at the end, inviting agreement. Tender but present, like she's right there with the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは森の静寂を楽しまれた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, he really enjoyed the quiet of the forest.
lines.style: Quieter here. A small smile in the voice. Slower still. The kind of memory that settles before you say it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お仕事の後は脱力されてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear—he'd completely lose himself after work, wouldn't he?
lines.style: Knowing and warm. A soft chuckle beneath the surface. She's remembering him in that moment, easy and unwound.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは化合物の実験をされたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, he used to do chemistry experiments with compounds.
lines.style: Still wistful, but with a slight uptick—pride in what he did. Not fast, but attentive. Like he's placing the memory carefully.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、退院した矢先に再入院されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear—and then he went right back to the hospital after he got out, didn't he?
lines.style: Shift here—tender but sadder. The lilt drops. She's remembering the worry alongside the love. Close, intimate, like she's telling him she remembers too.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが田んぼに在来種の稲を植えられた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, he planted traditional rice varieties in the paddies.
lines.style: The memory carries weight now. Respectful pace. Voice steady but warm. Like he's honoring what his father cared for.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、村の祭典で太鼓を叩かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear—and he beat the drum at the village festival, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm, wistful close. Voice soft and close, almost at his ear. Pride and tenderness meeting. The tone of an ending, complete.
